info.name: MoveOS Full Flow
info.description: End-to-end driver app flow ordered by typical call sequence; each request goes via API Gateway with downstream service noted. Run the requests top-to-bottom. The onboarding and auth OTP requests save dynamic Postman variables automatically. Ride lifecycle requests require ride_id to point at an existing Ride row because this backend has no public create-ride endpoint. Location/Ola Maps requests require LOCATION_SERVICE_URL and OLA_MAPS_API_KEY to be configured in the running services.

item.name: Accept Offer (dispatch)
item.description: Gateway → dispatch-service: atomic accept race.

exec: pm.test('Accept Offer (dispatch) returned a non-5xx response', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

exec: pm.test('Reject Offer (dispatch) returned a non-5xx response', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

item.name: Organizations (gateway → api-gateway)
item.description: Organization onboarding and fleet-management endpoints. Seeded fixtures: org-himalayan-fleet, org-kumaon-rides, vehicle UK05TA4321, driver driver-org-mohan, invite token himalayan-driver-invite-dev. Run Admin OTP first to populate admin_token.

item.name: Admin OTP - Verify
item.description: Verifies the super-admin OTP and stores admin_token for protected organization requests.

item.description: Lists all organizations. Saves useful seeded IDs for later requests.

item.name: Admin - List Organizations by Status
item.description: Filters organizations waiting for review.

item.name: Admin - Create Organization

  "legalName": "Postman Demo Logistics Pvt Ltd",
  "tradeName": "Postman Demo Fleet",
  "ownerPhone": "{{postman_org_owner_phone}}",
  "ownerEmail": "owner+{{run_id}}@postman-demo.example",
  "ownerName": "Postman Owner",
  "gstin": "05AAPCP1234K1Z9",
  "pan": "AAPCP1234K",
  "planTier": "SOLO"

item.description: Creates a draft organization as SUPER_ADMIN. Uses postman_org_owner_phone collection variable.

item.name: Admin - Get Organization Details
item.description: Gets full organization details, including members, drivers, vehicles, documents, audit events, and org KYC. Saves IDs from the seeded active org.

item.name: Admin - Update Organization Status
item.description: Approves the seeded pending organization. Use Reset/Seed DB if you want it back in PENDING_REVIEW.

item.name: Admin - Review Organization Document
item.description: Reviews an organization document as SUPER_ADMIN.

item.name: Admin - Review Organization Driver Compliance
item.description: Approves, suspends, or removes a driver link inside an organization.

item.name: Admin - Review KYC Record
item.description: Reviews an organization KYC record as SUPER_ADMIN.

item.name: Org - My Memberships
item.description: Returns memberships for the current token. For SUPER_ADMIN seeded login this is usually empty unless the user is also an org member.

item.name: Org - Get Organization
item.description: Read-side organization detail endpoint. SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN can access it.

item.name: Org - Update Organization Details
item.description: Updates organization details. SUPER_ADMIN token is accepted by this endpoint.

item.name: Org - List Members
item.description: Lists active/non-removed organization members and their users.

item.name: Org - Update Member Role or Status
item.description: Updates a member. This sample keeps the seeded owner unchanged.

item.name: Org - List Drivers
item.description: Lists organization-driver links and driver KYC.

item.name: Org - List Vehicles
item.description: Lists active organization-vehicle links and nested vehicle documents/assignments.

item.name: Org - List KYC
item.description: Lists organization-level KYC records.

item.name: Org - List Invitations
item.description: Lists organization invitations. SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN can read.

item.name: Org - Audit Log
item.description: Reads recent organization audit events.

item.name: Public - Invitation Details
item.description: Public invite landing-page lookup. Defaults to seeded token himalayan-driver-invite-dev.

item.name: Org Member - Create Invitation
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member. SUPER_ADMIN token is intentionally not enough for this write endpoint.

item.name: Org Member - Plate Check
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member.

item.name: Org Member - Register Vehicle
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member. Saves created vehicle id when successful.

item.name: Org Member - Upload Vehicle Document
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member and a vehicle owned by the org.

item.name: Org Member - Submit Vehicle KYC
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member and a vehicle owned by the org.

item.name: Org Member - Create Driver Vehicle Assignment
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member. Uses seeded driver and vehicle IDs by default.

item.name: Org Member - Update Assignment
item.description: Requires org_member_token for an ACTIVE organization member.
